db-wp7-gates.what: the WP7B anonymity core and the WP7D governed subject discovery

db-wp8-gates.what: WP8's onboarding repair, the client-write reachability assertion and report configuration; and D-093 T1 and T2: an operational state has one path, and its change says what it was

db-r1-gates.what: the systemic repair: an answer is never lost to a finish (R1), and a provisioned person can sign in while a stranger cannot provision themselves (F-01..F-03)

db-bob01-gates.what: BOB-01's school structure functions (who may build a school's Bagian, Tingkat and Kelas, and every refusal's stable code) and the intake's M5a place and year rules; and BOB-08's structure integrity: nothing placed or granted in a deactivated place, a year near now, the national library not a school, and one way in; and BOB-20's staff visibility: a school's admin sees its own staff and waiting list, never another school's, a platform person or a learner's view, and seeing grants nothing; and BOB-21's grants: a school-scoped grant needs the grant's own school, never an id alone

db-bob02-gates.what: BOB-02's lesson package: the sample workbook materialised whole, the structured-package confirmation, a failed save that undoes its confirmation, coded problems, who may prepare or confirm, and media upload authority; and BOB-11's staff preview of a school's unreleased media (F11-P04)

db-bob03-gates.what: BOB-03's release path: a school's course approved, created, frozen and published by the people the capabilities name, the release authored by the course's author, readiness measured at the seal, the revision's next version, and every refusal's stable code; and releases changing only through their functions (D-041); and BOB-17's readiness codes (F12-P04), publish_readiness internal only (F12-P05)

db-bob04-gates.what: BOB-04's whole learning cycle: a course carrying its pre-test and post-test, one assignment making both, the draw following the marks, INV-24 checked at assignment, every refusal's stable code, and a stranger refused the cycle; and the upload refusing a parallel group that spans both tests (D-040)

db-l1f4-gates.what: L1-F4's registry: every foreign key to persons(id) classified guarded or exempt with a reason, every guarded column with its trigger

db-bob06-gates.what: BOB-06's standard reports: every school carries PINTAR's class and school reports from creation, in the standard assembly, and PINTAR's rows and the provisioning pass are nobody else's

db-bob12-gates.what: BOB-12's card cooldown: 5 free attempts in 15 minutes, then 30 s doubling to a 5-minute cap, forgotten after 15 minutes, never a lock; a sign-in clears it and an attempt Auth never judged counts for nothing; the table and both functions are the sign-in route's alone (service_role)

db-bob24-gates.what: BOB-24's identity foundation: a PINTAR ID random, well-formed, distinct and immutable, read as ruled; usernames under C9 with reserved names, claimed once, never renamed but by the platform admin's audited correction; a blocklisted, bcrypt-hashed personal PIN set once; set-up state for staff EMAIL accounts only; the recovery ladder 1 h, 4 h, suspended, decaying but never lifting a suspension, restored only with a new PIN; the tables and recovery functions nobody's but the routes'

db-bob39-gates.what: BOB-39's referral: «Diteruskan ke pihak sekolah» in the Studio's integrity review raises the INTEGRITY_REFERRAL decision in the same transaction, so the Head of Department's /pimpinan queue shows it

db-bob25-gates.what: BOB-25's send log and limits: email_send_reserve refuses by each scope and counts what it should, a send settles once, and no client role reaches the log

db-bob26-gates.what: BOB-26's activation: nobody renames themselves at the table, a password needs a permit, a code goes only to an unfinished set-up, set-up needs the name, the correction is the platform admin's, the name step closes, and an import's names are its own school's

db-bob37-gates.what: BOB-37's per-topic mastery: class.topic_mastery and institution.competency_outcomes average each learner's recorded penguasaan from the {benar, total, penguasaan} objects the scoring writes, so the teacher's «Penguasaan per bagian» and the school's competency outcomes can show

db-bob35-gates.what: BOB-35's provenance: a session records a release of its definition's course or none is opened; a corrected-release move carries the cycle's PRE_TEST and POST_TEST to the target's own definitions or is refused, and is refused once any learner has started

db-bob36-gates.what: BOB-36's Uji Cepat rules: once a session cites an ad-hoc definition, its twelve interpretive fields and its status are fixed for every role, the owner included, while its title and an unsat definition stay editable

db-bob50-gates.what: BOB-50's certificate rule (D-082(d)): a single Uji Cepat is not eligible and nothing is prepared for it, the cycle's Uji Penguasaan still certifies, and the mode policy lint names QUICK if it certifies again; an Uji Cepat in progress keeps its verdict
